title: Analytic: surface plasmon polariton on a Drude metal (H_z)
description:
An H_z mode source launches the surface plasmon polariton along a Drude metal / air interface toward +x; two mode monitors downstream (FDTD).
Analytic: n_spp = sqrt(eps_m / (eps_m + 1)); the mode power decays as exp(-4 pi |Im n| d / lambda), 1/e length L_spp.
Derived values tab: n_eff_source, n_eff_imag_source, fraction_near / fraction_far and L_measured vs their references.
Spectra tab: em.near_monitor / em.far_monitor quantity fraction_positive vs the dashed exp(-4 pi |Im n| d / lambda). The curve errors are relative to the curve's range over 520-580 nm (0.7 % near, 6 % far), so a ~0.5 % absolute deviation at the band ends (likely the off-centre mode-source launch) shows as ~0.8 (near) and ~0.08 (far); a lossless metal would give ~4 for both.
Fields tab: hz bound to the interface.

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain width (CPML on x_lo, x_hi; the metal runs into both)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height (pec y_lo inside the metal, CPML y_hi in air)

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (about 9 cells per metal decay length)

parameters.name: eps_m_re
parameters.description: Re eps of the metal at lambda0 (Drude, exp(+j omega t))

parameters.name: eps_m_im
parameters.description: Im eps of the metal at lambda0 (< 0 = loss)

parameters.name: n2_re
parameters.description: Re n_spp^2, n_spp^2 = eps_m eps_d / (eps_m + eps_d) with eps_d = 1

parameters.name: L_spp
parameters.description: analytic 1/e propagation length of the SPP power [m]

parameters.name: decay_air
parameters.description: 1/e field decay length into the air [m] (lossless estimate)

parameters.name: decay_metal
parameters.description: 1/e field decay length into the metal [m] (lossless estimate)

analytic_curves.name: decay_near
analytic_curves.expression: exp(-4*pi*(x_near - x_src)/wavelength*(wp_metal**2*gamma_metal/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)*((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2)))/(2*(eps_inf_metal - wp_metal**2/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2) + 1)**2*sqrt((eps_inf_metal - wp_metal**2/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2))/(eps_inf_metal - wp_metal**2/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2) + 1))))

analytic_curves.name: decay_far
analytic_curves.expression: exp(-4*pi*(x_far - x_src)/wavelength*(wp_metal**2*gamma_metal/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)*((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2)))/(2*(eps_inf_metal - wp_metal**2/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2) + 1)**2*sqrt((eps_inf_metal - wp_metal**2/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2))/(eps_inf_metal - wp_metal**2/((2*pi*c_const/wavelength)**2 + gamma_metal**2) + 1))))
